title: Sentinel Rule Record
description: Static, machine-readable rule record shape. See RULE_RECORD_SCHEMA.md for the human-readable specification, including the class-level minimum authority/risk invariants (S1-F001) that this schema alone cannot express as cross-field constraints. This schema is descriptive only and is not consumed by any runtime engine in S1.

waivable.description: Whether this rule may ever be the target of a WAIVER record. If true, any waiver against it requires authority at least equal to this rule's own `authority` fields (S1-F003).

evidence.description: The MINIMUM evidence class(es) always required for this rule's applies_when condition. Never a claim that every listed evidence class from EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_MODEL.md is universally required (S1-F002) — stronger, claim-specific evidence beyond this baseline is determined by the Task Contract/policy, not hardcoded here.

evidence_note.description: Free-text clarification of when stronger or different evidence applies beyond the baseline `evidence` array, since this schema cannot express full claim-specific conditionality (S1-F002).

exceptions.description: Built-in exceptions the rule itself always had. Distinct from a WAIVER record (a time-boxed departure filed separately under devos/changes/waivers/ and validated by validate-waivers.mjs, never by this file's validator).

effective_version.description: Null only when status is PROPOSED and the rule is not yet effective under any released version (S1-F007). Non-null (and required) for ACTIVE/SUPERSEDED/WAIVED/REJECTED rules.

proposed_effective_version.description: The version this rule would take effect at if/when its authorizing cycle (e.g. S1) is approved. Required (non-null) when status is PROPOSED; must be null otherwise (S1-F007).
